input_metadata.purpose: RAGAS-ready dataset built from separate generated answers and structured reference answer key files.

answer_key_metadata.title: Structured Reference Answer Key for MAS Evaluation
answer_key_metadata.purpose: Final structured reference answer key converted from the user-provided reference file; all 28 rows are included in final accuracy.
answer_key_metadata.important_note: This file preserves the structured answer-key schema while replacing reference answers with the user-provided final reference answers. retrieved_contexts are not treated as gold answers; they are recorded only for RAG diagnostics.

input_metadata.warning: retrieved_contexts are system retrieval outputs for RAG metric evaluation, not gold reference evidence.

metadata.method_note: This evaluator reads generated answers and the structured answer key directly. No prebuilt RAGAS dataset file is required or read. Answer Correctness and Answer Relevancy are computed for all rows. Faithfulness, Context Precision, Context Recall, Context Sufficiency and Context Utilization are computed only for rows with retrieved_contexts. Retrieved contexts are system outputs for RAG diagnostics, not gold references.
